description: You are a Telecom Network Specialist at an enterprise solutions firm. A client — a mid-size university campus — needs a complete network infrastructure design document for their new building complex. Create a professional network topology diagram in Wondershare EdrawMax that represents the campus network architecture. The diagram must include the following components: at least one perimeter firewall, at least one core router connected to the ISP, a core distribution layer switch, at least two access layer switches (one per building wing), at least three server nodes (file server, web server, DNS/DHCP server) in a server farm zone, at least four end-user devices (PCs or workstations), and at least two wireless access points for the wireless LAN. All devices must be connected with appropriate network cables or trunk links. The document must have at least two pages: Page 1 is the physical/logical network topology diagram; Page 2 contains the IP Addressing Plan as a structured table or list showing subnet assignments, IP ranges, VLAN IDs, and device roles. Apply a professional color theme. Save the completed diagram as '/home/ga/campus_network_topology.eddx'.
